description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Review model within the Opencart catalog module. It defines methods for adding reviews, retrieving reviews by product ID, and counting total reviews for a product.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Model class for handling product reviews in the Opencart catalog module, including adding reviews and retrieving review data.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review into the database for a specific product, with author, text, rating, and timestamp.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Counts the total number of reviews for a specific product.
